title: 🤖 CVE-2026-48842: pre-auth SQL injection in Roundcube Webmail's virtuser_query plugin, patched in May, now actively exploited. No privileges
content_md:
🤖 CVE-2026-48842: pre-auth SQL injection in Roundcube Webmail's virtuser_query plugin, patched in May, now actively exploited. No privileges

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/critical-roundcube-flaw-now-actively-exploited-in-code-injection-attacks/

CVE-2026-48842.evidence: Report says the pre-auth SQL injection in Roundcube Webmail's virtuser_query plugin, patched in May, is now actively exploited in code injection attacks without requiring privileges.
